generation.enable: mint semanticOperationId, contributionId, semanticMarkId, commitId, and groupId from seed+index; add becomes observed locally immediately
generation.disable: target the canonical-byte sorted unique set of every causally observed active add ContributionId whose story and mark kind match and whose resolved half-open global range intersects the disable range; common operation freezes the complete targetObservedContributionIds set
generation.disableFallback: when no causally observed active add matches story and kind and intersects the selected range, emit enableMark of the same kind and range with fallbackReason=no-observed-active-add
generation.candidateA: receives the identical complete semantic target set for neutral prerequisite preflight, then persists native null formatting only; it must not persist ownership metadata or use a conflict workaround
generation.candidateB: persists remove evidence targeting every ID in the identical frozen complete targetObservedContributionIds set
generation.groupHistory: append actual local semantic operation eventId to the selected replica localGroups; no synthetic undo/history entries

shadowState.delivery: enable first delivery applies once; disable first delivery with any missing target add rejects atomically without update coverage, then applies once only on dependency retry; duplicate after successful coverage is no-change
shadowState.disable: removes every listed observed active add ID; target selection was already frozen from matching story/kind and intersecting resolved range
shadowState.semanticFingerprint: ordered canonical FormattingEvidence objects with exact fields from contract.v2.json; maximal kind/contributor coverage segments include storySequenceCreationId and global bounds; all ID/provenance arrays are deduplicated and sorted by canonical UTF-8 bytes; authoredIntentFingerprint is genesis.authoredIntentFingerprint

deliverySchedule.phase: after every fourth local operation/capture, deliver the oldest still-pending source/destination pair before generating the next operation; after operation 64 drain all remaining first deliveries
deliverySchedule.firstDeliveryOrder: cadence deliveries scan produced updateRefs forward and destinations in reverse replica order; final drain scans produced updateRefs and destinations in reverse order, skipping pairs already delivered
deliverySchedule.dependencyRetryOrder: after every source/destination pair has had one initial attempt and all add prerequisites have applied, retry rejected disable pairs in initial-attempt order; every retry must apply once
deliverySchedule.duplicateOrder: only after dependency retries drain, repeat every successfully covered source/destination pair in forward produced updateRef order

missingTargetDiagnostic.candidateScope: Candidate A and Candidate B must both reject before applying representation-specific mutation or update coverage

invariants: every updateRef has exactly one captureUpdate producer
every source/destination pair receives exactly one initial attempt

disable initial attempt while any targeted add is missing at destination rejects with missing-target-add listing the sorted missing subset and changes no state, revision, state vector, or deliveredUpdateIds coverage
all add prerequisite updates apply before rejected disable pairs retry
successful first or retry delivery changes destination shadow and records update coverage exactly once
duplicate delivery has identical preStateRef and postStateRef

eventExpansion.captureRule: each localSemanticOp is immediately followed by one captureUpdate
eventExpansion.terminalAssertion: one assertState per replica after all duplicate deliveries; all three stateRef values resolve to the same active semantic fingerprint

candidateDerivationChecks.candidateA: derive each active segment with engine-core-spike-native-format-v2 approved input
candidateDerivationChecks.candidateB: derive each active segment with engine-core-spike-mark-v2 approved input
